$comment: Surge SLOs (ticket 023): the absolute pass criteria for each class of surge traffic, decided in ticket 020. Every `thresholds` entry is a k6 threshold expression and the `metric` is the k6 metric or sub-metric it applies to, so the scripts arm these verbatim (k6/lib/slos.js) and tools/surge-verdict.js reads the same file back against a k6 summary export. The trend run's ledger-derived thresholds are a different thing and do not live here. A class is added by adding a key under `classes` and naming it in the script that exercises it.
